tap.undoExpired: Too late to undo here. Open the group to change it.
tap.offlineBody: You're offline. It'll sync when you're back online.

who.title: Who are you?
who.subtitle: One tap and it's ticked off. We'll remember you on this device.
who.noMembers: No one here yet. Add yourself.

needsLink.title: Open the group link first
needsLink.body: This household only lets devices it already knows tick off chores from a tag. Open the group link on this device once (ask someone in {group} for it), pick who you are, then scan again.

errors.TAG_NOT_FOUND: This tag doesn't work (any more). It may have been replaced.
errors.TAG_REVOKED: This tag has been switched off. Ask your household for the new one.
errors.GROUP_MISMATCH: This tag belongs to a different group.
errors.JOIN_FROM_TAG_DISABLED: New people can't join from a tag in this household. Open the group link first.
errors.UNDO_NOT_ALLOWED: That can't be undone from here.
errors.UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED: Too late to undo here. Open the group to change it.
errors.MEMBER_ARCHIVED: That person has been archived. Pick someone else.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find you in this household. Pick again.

manage.title: Tags
manage.subtitle: Stick a label where the job happens. Turn on a QR code, an NFC tag or both: scanning or tapping it ticks off that chore, and only that chore.
manage.pinHelp: This group has a settings PIN. Enter it to create, replace or revoke tags.
manage.qrToggleHint: Print a QR code that anyone can scan with their phone camera.
manage.nfcToggleHint: Mark the label for an NFC sticker that you write with this tag's link. Phones tick it off with a tap.
manage.noCapabilityHint: With both off, the tag is just a link (handy for shortcuts or home automation). There's nothing to print.
manage.label: Label (optional)
manage.empty: No tags yet. Create one for a chore, then print its label or write the NFC tag.
manage.noChores: Add a chore first, then come back to make a tag for it.
manage.qrHelp: Scan with a phone camera to test it. It won't tick anything off until you pick who you are.
manage.nfcReady: Hold an NFC tag to the back of your phone…
manage.nfcWritten: Tag written. Give it a tap to test.
manage.nfcUnsupportedTitle: Write the tag with an app
manage.nfcUnsupported: Writing NFC tags from the browser only works in Chrome on Android. On iPhone, use an app such as NFC Tools: choose Write → Add a record → URL, paste the link below, then hold the tag to the top of your phone.
manage.rotateBody: The old code stops working right away and a new one is made for the same chore. You'll need to reprint or rewrite the physical tag.
manage.rotated: New tag made. Reprint or rewrite it.
manage.revokeBody: Scanning it will stop working right away. This can't be undone, but you can make a new tag any time.

print.title: Print labels
print.subtitle: Pick the labels to print, then print on A4. Cut along the lines and stick each one where the job happens. For labels marked Tap, write an NFC sticker with the tag's link and stick it behind the label.
print.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# label selected} other {# labels selected}}
print.empty: No labels to print. Create a tag with a QR code or NFC turned on first.

hint.QR: Scan with your phone camera to tick off
hint.NFC: Tap your phone here to tick off
hint.both: Scan or tap your phone to tick off
